## Carried here · 2026-10-31T05:45Z · ⛔ not a claim

The delta contract review of PR #28317 at `30dc6587` (verdict PASS, no must-fix) adds four should-fixes. They join this card's SF2, SF3 and SF6:

- `revoke()` and `connect()` still do a bare `read()` after `engineOrThrow`. A throwing store there answers an undeclared 500, while the spec docblock promises 503. Route both through `readOrRefuse`.
- `requestOAuth2Token` should use `redirect: 'error'`, so that a token endpoint cannot 307 the form body (client secret, refresh token) off https.
- Drop or dev-gate the `*.localhost` arm of the loopback allowance; the glibc resolver does not special-case it. Add `http://localhost@evil.com` and `http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]` to the refuse pins.
- The S1 changeset should gain a bullet for the https-only and loopback rule (docs only).
